message.abstract: <jats:p>Based on barcoding (ITS nrDNA) and morphological studies of specimens deposited in H and OULU, basidiomycetes Rhizopogon evadens and R. ochroleucoides are recorded for the first time for Europe, R. graveolens and R. verii for Finland, and R. mohelnensis for Estonia.</jats:p>
title: Additions to Rhizopogon (Boletales, Basidiomycota) in Finland and Europe Based on Molecular and Morphological Evidence
